rules.predicate: producer task_id is present in consumer.authority_gates
producer task_id is present in consumer.integration_inputs
producer task_id is present in consumer.source_requirement_predecessors
producer and consumer share a write scope, have no dependency path forcing order before conflict resolution, and deterministic_conflict_order orders producer before consumer

oracle_rule: For each explicit deps edge exactly one of the first four predicates MUST be true and its derived class MUST equal deps[*].provenance. Conflict-serialization edges are derived mechanically and MUST NOT be authored as explicit deps. Zero or multiple matching predicates is an invalid fixture.
unsupported_edge_rule: An effective edge is unsupported if it lacks exactly one derivable permitted provenance class under these rules.
conflict_rule: Only the minimum deterministic serialization edges needed to order each write-conflict set are added; these edges participate in critical-path and wave recomputation.
